title: Glutinous
summary: GLU'TINOUS, noun [Latin glutinosus.] Viscous; viscid; tenacious; having the quality of glue; resembling glue. Starch is glutinous 1. In botany, besmeared with a slippery moisture; as a glutinous leaf.
